description: `__len__` plus `__getitem__` give a class `len()`, indexing, slicing, iteration, `in` and `reversed()`.
An abstract base class that adds `__contains__`, `__iter__`, `__reversed__`, `index` and `count` once you implement the two methods.
Raised for an out-of-range integer index. The iteration fallback uses it to know when to stop.
Without `__iter__`, Python iterates by calling `__getitem__` with 0, 1, 2... until `IndexError`.
